description: This file defines the Membership class within the OrangeHRM reporting system. The class extends ListableDisplayField and specifies methods to return DTO class name, entity aliases, and relevant fields related to employee memberships.

classes.name: Membership
classes.description: Represents a display field for membership-related data in the reporting system, providing DTO class info, entity aliases, and specific fields for report generation.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the associated Data Transfer Object (DTO) for membership data.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in the report context, here 'membership'.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of field names used for report generation, specifically 'employee.empNumber'.
